strings.אין להאשים משפחה, להפסיק תמיכה בפתאומיות: Do not blame family, abruptly withdraw support or change responses without an individualized plan. Preserve warmth, connection, practical help and necessary protections. Sharing personal information requires appropriate consent and safeguarding obligations.
strings.אין שמירה אוטומטית ואין שליחה לרשת. השתמ: Nothing is saved automatically or sent over the network. Use fictional information for review. If an answer does not fit, shorten it or save the complete answers as text and move them to a continuation page. Check print preview.
strings.איפה היה לחץ או חוסר הבנה שחשוב להביא לט: Where was there pressure or misunderstanding to discuss in treatment?
strings.אפשר להציע קריאה, זמן ושיחה לפי העדפה. ס: Offer reading support, time, and conversation according to preference. Choose help from another person together with the participant, respecting their privacy.
Check whether coordination supported functioning, relationships and choice. Record misunderstood responses and return to the therapist before further change. Success is not measured by absence of requests or emotions.
strings.בחרו בדף לאחר הערכה מקצועית ובהסכמה. אפש: Choose this sheet following professional assessment and with consent. The person may skip questions, answer aloud, or choose another tool. This is proposed original material for review; it provides no score, diagnosis, or promise of an outcome.
strings.בחרו מצב שהאדם מעוניין לבדוק. אין צורך ל: Choose a situation the person wants to explore. It need not be the hardest situation. Check that the question is understood and the wording fits the person; their account comes before the therapist's interpretation.
strings.גילי 12–17. קובעים עם המתבגר מה יישאר בש: Ages 12–17. Agree what stays private and what is shared with family or school, subject to safeguarding duties. Embarrassing thought content need not be disclosed. A parent agreement does not authorize blanket school sharing.
strings.גילי 8–11 בלבד. המטפל מקריא שאלה אחת ומא: Ages 8–11 only. Read one question and allow brief or spoken answers. Parents add separate observations without deciding the child's thoughts; do not test reporting accuracy. Parents do not monitor the child's thoughts.
strings.דוגמה בדויה: משפחתו של עידו מתארת בקשות: Fictional example: Ido's family describes repeated reassurance requests before leaving home. The therapist separately hears Ido's wishes and the parents' difficulties, then explores a coordinated response. The sheet does not decide what to stop or when.
strings.דף P הוא הצעה לתיעוד החלטה ולמידה במסגרת: The P sheet proposes recording decisions and learning within treatment, not ERP instructions. The therapist determines suitability, action, scope and support. Without an agreed plan, use only for discussion. Do not begin exposure or change response prevention based on this sheet.
strings.האם יכולתי להחליט ולבטא העדפה בזמן אמת?: Could I decide and express preferences at the time?
strings.האם כובדו הדברים שבחרתי לשתף או לשמור לע: Were my choices about sharing and privacy respected?
strings.האם משהו בתגובה של המבוגר בלבל אותי?: Did anything in the adult's response confuse me?
strings.האם נשמרה עזרה מעשית לצד גבולות התוכנית?: Was practical help preserved alongside plan boundaries?

strings.הציעו שאלה אחת בכל פעם ומעט כתיבה. תיווך: Offer one question at a time with little writing. Adult support must not replace the child's own voice.
strings.הקישורים הבאים שימשו לרקע בלבד. השאלות ו: The following links were used for background only. Questions and adaptations were written afresh for the expansion plan; no questionnaire, scale, or protocol was copied. Adult sources do not validate the child versions. This material makes no claim about session count or treatment effectiveness.

strings.טיוטה לסקירה. מתעדים רק המשך שהותאם עם מ: Draft for review. Record only follow-up adapted with a therapist; this sheet sets no exercise or dosage.
strings.טיוטה לסקירת מנהל. סקירה קלינית ואישור ז: Draft for administrator review. Clinical review and final rights approval are still pending.
strings.יחידה 4 עוסקת בתוכנית האישית; יחידה 7 מת: Unit 4 addresses the personal plan; unit 7 focuses on interaction and coordinated support. FAMILY supports discussion but does not replace professional decisions about participation in rituals.

strings.למפות בהסכמה את ההבדל בין תמיכה באדם לבי: With consent, map the difference between supporting the person and participating in an OCD cycle. Record roles defined by the therapist with the person and supporters.

strings.מחברים את העבודה למטרות שהאדם בחר ולהקשר: Connect work to chosen goals, family, employment and existing care. Distinguish rituals, practical needs and value-consistent behavior. Participants may set limits on their ability to help.
strings.מחלוקת בין מלווים או עומס אינם חוסר אכפת: Supporter disagreement or overload does not mean lack of care. First explore ability and boundaries. Without agreement or where harm is feared, avoid family response changes and consult a professional.

strings.מי היה איתי כשהייתי צריך עזרה?: Who was with me when I needed help?
strings.מי מעורב במצב ובמי אני בוחר להיעזר?: Who is involved and whose help do I choose?

strings.סכמו מה הובן ומה נשאר פתוח. היעזרו ב־SES: Summarize what became clearer and what remains open. Use the existing SES-S01 and SES-S02 for the session framework. There is no need to repeat an assessment or plan already recorded.

strings.קיימת רשומת סקירה נפרדת לכל גרסה: התאמת: Each version has a separate review record covering age suitability, originality, rights, and fictional filling. Reviewer and date fields remain blank until assigned. File checks or a code merge are not clinical approval. Clinical information stays only in the authorized setting, outside the code repository.
strings.שומרים על שפה בוגרת, בחירה ופרטיות. בודק: Preserve adult language, choice and privacy. Assess access, health and desired support without automatically attributing new changes to OCD or assuming reduced ability. Medical or functional help is not stopped merely because it recurs.
